Faridabad Police Destroy Seized Narcotics Worth ₹5 Crore

Faridabad police destroyed approximately 553 kilograms of seized narcotics, including cannabis, opium, and heroin, valued at ₹5 crore. The drugs were confiscated in 425 different cases. Separately, in an incident reported in Faridabad, a former village head alleged that she was drugged and robbed of gold weighing 70 tolas and 2.5 kilograms of silver, with the stolen goods valued at ₹1.5 crore.
